angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 916,515 km at 99.31 pc = 0.12 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 10.0693 +/- 0.0235 mas (same row, RUWE 1.09): 99.31 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.3174 +/- 0.0249 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 77946 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 916,515 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.1973 +/- 0.0308 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 77946 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6007 +/- 83 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 77946 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 77946 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-77946.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.277, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 77946 (pscomppars): spectral type F5, from Palethorpe et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.529.3323P/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 77946: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 77946 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.215 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 77946 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.30878, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 77946 (pscomppars): age 3.1 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 77946 (pscomppars): rotation period 13.56 d, from Palethorpe et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.529.3323P/abstract)
